target: Declare the DCP-MCP-RO series READY: run scripts/audit/exact_head_readiness.py at the exact series head with all prior packets' trusted-audit and live evidence, classify every review item, confirm no unknown reviewer/bot and no unresolved blocking thread, update BUILD_SERIES.md with the close-out roadmap rows (0011-0025), and publish the final series proof bundle.
invariants: One public MCP endpoint; no backend ports exposed; no backend writes; no lifecycle mutations from the facade.
target_id is the only caller-facing handle; callers never supply paths, URLs, ports, workspace IDs, or runtime selectors.
Runtime discovery never grants exposure; port leases never prove ownership; heuristics may discover but never authorize; ambiguity blocks; cross-repo mounts block.
A skipped live gate is NOT a pass (ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md proof rule); never rewrite a historical PARTIAL/SKIPPED verdict - append new evidence.
Proof must be current to the exact head SHA (scripts/audit/exact_head_readiness.py contract).
STOP IF: the embedded auditor returns FAIL or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
READY only if the evaluator passes at the exact head: stale proof, skipped audit, failed/pending checks, unknown reviewers, unresolved threads, or allowlist drift each block.
No verdict rewriting: the close-out records the full PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN history per packet.
STOP IF: exact_head_readiness reports any blocking condition - fix upstream, never patch the evaluator.

pr.title: docs(dcp): DCP-MCP-RO series READY - close-out and final proof
pr.body:
Final series gate: exact-head readiness evaluation with trusted audits and live evidence attached, review-item classification, BUILD_SERIES close-out for 0011-0025, and the final series proof bundle.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

steps.task: Run the exact-head readiness evaluator against the series head; walk its findings to closure (review classification, thread resolution upstream); update BUILD_SERIES.md roadmap rows for 0011-0025 with final verdicts; assemble the series-level proof bundle indexing every packet's proof.
requirements: Evaluator output attached (READY) at the exact head SHA.
Review-item classification table complete; no unknown reviewer/bot.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff/evidence.
validation: Evaluator returns READY at the exact head; any blocker stops the packet.
Series proof indexes all packet proofs with their final buckets.

steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0025/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDITOR_REPORT.md) with embedded_audit conforming to schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json, and record PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets honestly (NOT_RUN never collapsed into PASS).
requirements: COMMAND_LOG.md with outputs and exit codes.
validation: python3 scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py passes on the new PROOF.json.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).
